```{r}

library(tidyverse)

library(httr2)

```

```{r}
raw <- jsonlite::read_json("data/wildfires.geojson")
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
pluck(raw, "features", 1) |> names()
```

```{r}
pluck(raw, "features", 1, "geometry", "coordinates", 1, 1)
```

```{r}
tibble(features = raw$features)
```
